{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify invalid age values
invalid_age_mask = sales['customer_age'] == -1
invalid_count = invalid_age_mask.sum()

# Check how many converted customers have invalid age
converted_invalid_mask = invalid_age_mask & (sales['converted'] == 1)
converted_invalid_count = converted_invalid_mask.sum()

# Filter converted customers excluding invalid age
converted_customers_clean = sales[(sales['converted'] == 1) & (sales['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age of converted customers (excluding invalid ages)
mean_age_converted_clean = converted_customers_clean['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required values
print(f"Total rows with customer_age == -1: {invalid_count}")
print(f"Converted customers with customer_age == -1: {converted_invalid_count}")
print(f"Number of converted customers after excluding invalid ages: {len(converted_customers_clean)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding customer_age == -1): {mean_age_converted_clean}")"}
